name: Room Finishes from Zones
summary: Adds the floor finish, the ceiling and the wall finishes of the selected zones from favorites or materials, and replaces them on a re-run.

versions.changelog: Doors, windows and openings kept clear: each wall finish gets an opening, cutting only the finish, for every door, window and opening behind it, with a margin for frames (Archicad 29 and later). The summary lists them per zone and gives the wall finish area with the openings deducted.
Wall finishes: a wall along every part of a zone edge with a wall behind it, growing into the room from the floor finish's top to the ceiling's bottom (Archicad 28 and later).
First version: floor finishes and ceilings.
